facts.claim: By then [1995-96] the northern range elk herd numbered nearly twenty thousand.
facts.problem: Not wrong, but borderline. The northern range count peaked at roughly 19,000 in the winter of 1993-94; the winter 1994-95 count was closer to 17,000. 'Nearly twenty thousand' describes the peak just before reintroduction rather than the count in the release years. Confidence: medium. Low-stakes for the items (q08 does not rest on it).

facts.claim: fourteen wolves from Alberta in 1995, seventeen from British Columbia in 1996, thirty-one founders in total
facts.problem: Accurate for 1995-96. For completeness, ten additional pups from northwestern Montana were released in 1997, so some sources give a higher founder total; the passage's thirty-one is the standard figure for the two-year reintroduction and q08 is explicitly scoped to 1995 and 1996. Confidence: high that the passage is fine as written.
